key.name: modules-media
key.description: What is playing, from any MPRIS player, with its tab.

key.name: modules-notification
key.description: The Notifications tab (notifications in the pill come later).

key.name: modules-hud
key.description: Shows the volume, brightness and caps lock changes in the pill instead of the stock popup.

key.name: modules-home
key.description: The blocks of the Home tab.

key.name: modules-progress
key.description: File copies and downloads, with the Transfers tab.

key.name: modules-timer
key.description: Timers in the pill, with the Timer tab.

key.name: modules-calendar
key.description: The Calendar tab, in the strip's slot unless another is chosen.

key.name: modules-copied
key.description: A short flash when something is copied.

key.name: modules-layout
key.description: A short flash when the input source changes.

key.name: modules-ask
key.description: Questions from scripts and coding agents, answered in the pill.

key.name: modules-clipboard
key.description: The Clipboard tab.

key.name: apps-hidden
key.description: Apps whose activities never show. Any id an app goes by; it is slugged.

key.name: apps-plain
key.description: Apps drawn by the default adapter instead of their own.

key.name: tabs-pinned
key.description: Standalone tabs shown in the strip all the time, besides the slot.

key.name: tabs-slot
key.summary: Standalone tab in the strip's slot
key.description: Set by choosing a tab from ⋯. Empty or not enabled: the first enabled standalone tab.

key.name: expanded-width
key.description: In logical px; 0 derives it from the monitor (560–760 px). Height follows the content, up to half the width.

key.name: dev-mode
key.description: Lets Looking Glass reload one module without restarting the Shell.

key.name: keybind-focus
key.description: Takes the keyboard: ←/→ between pills, Enter opens, Esc or this key again lets go; an open ask answers to the key printed on its buttons.

key.name: cluster-background
key.description: The dark rounded background behind the left and right clusters: never, only while the pointer is over one, or always.

key.name: cluster-radius
key.description: Of the cluster background, in logical px; 16 is a pill like the island.

key.name: cluster-opacity
key.description: Of the cluster background, in percent.
